units.source_text: 且说源氏太政大臣发心营造一所清静的宅院。

en.t: Now Genji, the Grand Minister, resolved to build a quiet residence.

units.source_text: 他的主意是：既然要造，不如造得大些，讲究些，

en.t: His idea was that, since he was going to build it, he might as well make it larger and more elegant,

units.source_text: 好让散居各处而难得见面的人，尤其是僻处山乡的明石姬等，大家集中在一起。

en.t: so that those who lived scattered in different places and rarely had the chance to meet, especially Lady Akashi and the others secluded in the mountain village, could all gather together.

units.source_text: 于是在六条地方，即六条妃子旧邸一带，选定一块地皮，划分四区，大兴土木。

en.t: So in the Rokujo district, around the former residence of the Rokujo lady, he selected a site, divided it into four sections, and began construction on a grand scale.

units.source_text: 明年是紫姬的父亲式部卿亲王五十大庆，紫姬正在准备祝寿之事。

en.t: The following year would be the fiftieth birthday celebration of Prince Shikibukyo, Lady Murasaki's father, and Lady Murasaki was preparing the festivities.

units.source_text: 源氏也认为此事不可简慢，应该及早筹办。

en.t: Genji also felt that the matter must not be treated lightly and should be arranged well in advance.

units.source_text: 既然要祝寿，不如在新邸举行，更为体面。

en.t: Since they were to hold a birthday celebration, it would be more fitting to hold it at the new residence.

units.source_text: 便命赶紧动工，务求克日完成。

en.t: He therefore ordered the work to begin at once and insisted that it be completed by the appointed date.
